items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: Yes, a master, definitely. Taught me how to use the hi-hat listening to him

ctx.x: That’s great. It’s neat to hear. People like Tony Williams, those kind of drummers, do you enjoy them also?

Yes, a master, definitely. Taught me how to use the hi-hat listening to him, and he played the hi-hat on all four, and I do that sometimes — sometimes too, I’ll wake up the bass player, or to calm them down, because that’ll draw, it draws attention without slamming down a bass drum, so I would use that technique sometimes with a piano player. So I use a jazz technique in a big band, so I pull from him, definitely a master, a powerful, powerful drummer. So sad that he left us so early.
What do you think of the state of jazz today?
